title: Director of Sales Manager
description:
Pinterest is seeking a Director of Sales Manager who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Director of Sales Manager, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our general capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute general initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 9+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Microsoft Office, Analytical Thinking, Communication, Project Management
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €30,000 – €50,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

description:
Join Cloudflare as a Associate DevOps Engineer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Associate DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making

- Team player with a proactive mindset

- Hybrid work options available

- Professional development opportunities

- Modern office with great amenities

We are looking for a talented Lead Recruiter to join our dynamic team at American Express. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining design solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 2 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Illustrator, Microsoft Office, Analytical Thinking, Leadership
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of €95,000 – €130,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

labcorp is seeking a Senior Mobile Developer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

- Expertise in Python, React, Project Management, Node.js

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Hybrid work options available

- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match

title: Lead Supply Chain Manager
description:
Join Delta Airlines as a Lead Supply Chain Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Lead Supply Chain Manager with strong expertise in general. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute general projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 3 years of experience as a Lead Supply Chain Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Team Management, Communication
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: €30,000 – €50,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

United Airlines is seeking a Principal Embedded Systems Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal Embedded Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 4+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in JavaScript, Communication, Agile, Git
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €130,000 – €180,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Join Toptal as a Lead UX Designer and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Lead UX Designer with strong expertise in design. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Plan, prioritize, and execute design projects to meet deadlines

- In-depth knowledge of Figma, Adobe XD, UI/UX, Photoshop
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**

- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Lead Automation Engineer
description:
American Express is seeking a Lead Automation Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Lead Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices

- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €70,000 – €95,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Principal Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Indeed is seeking a Principal Talent Acquisition Specialist who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our design capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute design initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 7+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Sketch, Adobe XD, Figma, Photoshop
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: €50,000 – €70,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours
